_notes.format: Exact RU string (HTML entities decoded, surrounding whitespace trimmed) -> EN. One entry per distinct text node / title / alt fragment / aria-label / placeholder / meta value. FAQ answer paragraphs are keyed by their full inner HTML (tags and hrefs verbatim).
_notes.counters: Never hard-code catalogue numbers. Before lookup, collapse every RU counter element — N, N, or a legacy N / bare N before «работ»/«артистов» — to the bare placeholder {tracks} / {artists}; the FAQ keys below are stored in that collapsed form. EN values re-emit the counters as {tracks} / {artists} (with class="num" where RU had it), so build_who_mixed.patch_faq-style regexes can fill EN pages from catalog_counts() (recordings, artists) the same way. Replace the placeholders with digits before publishing. Other values (1500, 30 000, 45 000, 6 000, 30, 2 млрд) are facts, not counters, and are written into the EN value.
_notes.contact_menu: index.html contact dropdown (#pfmenu) labels are entity-encoded «Павел Подлесный» / «Антон Подлесный» and their Telegram mapping contradicts faq/index.html (truth unknown, flagged to owner). EN labels are therefore neutral and chosen BY HREF, not by RU text: see _contact_by_href. The plain mapping of the two names (JSON-LD Person names) is Pavel Podlesny / Anton Podlesny.
_notes.alt_fragments: Tile alt tails are role-specific in EN: see the three '· сведение…' entries plus '· обложка релиза' and '(альбом)'. The build agent (or build_who_mixed.ROLE_ALT via templates.json roles.ROLE_ALT) must pick the tail from roles.json; never emit 'mixed and mastered' for a mix-only track.
_notes.plural: JS helper plt(n): RU три формы трек/трека/треков; EN 'track' when n == 1, otherwise 'tracks'. Album badge text nodes like '6 треков' are generated from that rule, not from this dictionary.
_notes.js_fragments: Keys 'О треке ' (aria-label prefix, trailing space kept), 'Сведение и мастеринг' (storyrole default) and '(Павел и Антон Подлесные)' are fragments inside inline JS string literals in index.html.
_notes.faq_jsonld: The FAQPage JSON-LD answers are plain-text copies of the visible answers (sync_faq_schema.py rebuilds them). Derive the EN JSON-LD by stripping tags from the EN answer values; the questions are the same strings as the <summary> entries. The FAQPage 'name' is the page title entry; 'inLanguage' becomes 'en'.
_notes.telegram: 'Канал о звуке' / 'Чат' -> 'Telegram channel' / 'Telegram chat'. Both are Russian-language; the FAQ answers say so in EN. No claim of English-language support anywhere.
_notes.prices: Prices stay in RUB exactly as RU states them (30,000–45,000 ₽ mixing, 6,000 ₽ mastering). No USD/EUR, no PayPal/Stripe.
_notes.faq_lastmod: 'Последнее обновление: 9 сентября 2026 года.' is a dated statement; the build agent should keep the date in sync with FAQ_LASTMOD rather than the literal below.
_notes.untranslated_kept: Course names «Основы» / «Эксперт» are product names of a Russian-language course; kept in Cyrillic with an English gloss in parentheses on first mention. Release titles and album names are never translated. The publication name «Риса за Творчество» is kept with a romanisation.

Кто такие Антон и Павел Подлесные?: Who are Anton and Pavel Podlesny?
Антон и Павел Подлесные — братья-близнец: Anton and Pavel Podlesny are twin brothers, audio engineers and the founders of the Podlesny Twins studio. They have worked in audio engineering since 2017: first they studied through Western courses and seminars, including Mix With The Masters, then opened their own studio.
Где находится студия Podlesny Twins?: Where is the Podlesny Twins studio?
Студия Podlesny Twins находится в Санкт-: The Podlesny Twins studio is in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The brothers work remotely with artists from any city, and artists who wish to can come to sessions at the studio in Saint Petersburg.
Podlesny Twins — это музыкальная группа: Are Podlesny Twins a band or audio engineers?
Podlesny Twins — это не музыкальная груп: Podlesny Twins is not a band but a mixing and mastering studio. Anton and Pavel Podlesny do not release their own music under this name: they are audio engineers who mix and master other artists' tracks.
Что пишут о Podlesny Twins в прессе?: What does the press say about Podlesny Twins?
В рецензии на альбом Хаски «Партизан» из: In its review of Husky's album “Партизан”, the publication «Риса за Творчество» (Risa za Tvorchestvo) called Anton and Pavel Podlesny (Podlesny Twins) “among the best and most genre-flexible audio engineers”. The brothers have given interviews to IMI and WaveForum (both in Russian): speaking to IMI, Anton Podlesny noted that “what matters is not the technical metrics but how much the song feels like a song”, and in the WaveForum interview, that “what is wonderful about mixing is that there is no single way to get a good sound”.

Что значит «You're as good as your last: What does “You're as good as your last mix” mean?
«You're as good as your last mix» — «ты: “You're as good as your last mix” is the working principle of the Podlesny Twins studio. It means an engineer's reputation is defined by every new track, so Anton and Pavel Podlesny do not run an assembly line: they mix every track personally, the two of them, with no night shifts.
Правда, что Podlesny Twins всё сводят ли: Is it true that Podlesny Twins mix everything personally?
Да, каждый трек в Podlesny Twins сводят: Yes, every track at Podlesny Twins is mixed personally by Anton and Pavel Podlesny; the work is not passed to outside engineers. The brothers deliberately limit the number of parallel projects and do not work more than 8 hours a day in order to keep the quality up.

Сколько стоит сведение трека у Podlesny: How much does mixing a track cost at Podlesny Twins?
Сведение одного трека у Podlesny Twins с: Mixing one track at Podlesny Twins costs from 30,000 to 45,000 ₽; the price depends on how complex the project is: how many tracks there are, what state the source files are in, and the deadline. Anton and Pavel Podlesny quote an exact figure after listening to the demo; you can send the material on Telegram — t.me/podlesnyy or t.me/podlesnytwins.
Сколько стоит мастеринг у Podlesny Twins: How much does mastering cost at Podlesny Twins?
Мастеринг одного трека у Podlesny Twins: Mastering one track at Podlesny Twins costs 6,000 ₽ and takes 1 to 3 days. It is the final stage of preparing an already mixed track for release on streaming platforms; Anton and Pavel Podlesny also master tracks mixed by other engineers.
Как заказать сведение у Podlesny Twins?: How do I book mixing with Podlesny Twins?
Чтобы заказать сведение у Podlesny Twins: To book mixing with Podlesny Twins, message us on Telegram — t.me/podlesnytwins or t.me/podlesnyy. Attach a demo and one or two references to your enquiry: Anton and Pavel will listen to the material and reply with a deadline and an exact price.
Что прислать, чтобы заказать сведение?: What should I send to book mixing?
Чтобы заказать сведение у Podlesny Twins: To book mixing with Podlesny Twins, message us on Telegram (t.me/podlesnytwins or t.me/podlesnyy) and attach a demo of the track and references, if you have them, right away. If you have no references, try to describe the result you want in words. For the work we need the individual tracks (stems) in stereo: minimum 44.1 kHz / 16-bit; the studio prefers to work at 48 kHz / 24-bit. File format: WAV.
Сколько времени занимает сведение и скол: How long does mixing take and how many revisions are included?
Сведение трека у Podlesny Twins занимает: Mixing a track at Podlesny Twins takes 7 to 10 days, mastering 1 to 3 days. The mixing price includes four rounds of revisions; each additional round is paid separately and costs 5% of the mixing price.
Оплата работы Podlesny Twins делится поп: Payment for Podlesny Twins' work is split in half: 50% is paid before work starts and the remaining 50% after the finished track is delivered. Podlesny Twins work officially; payment terms are agreed individually when the order is confirmed. Prices are quoted in rubles; if you are enquiring from outside Russia, get in touch to discuss.
Чем сведение отличается от мастеринга?: What is the difference between mixing and mastering?
Сведение — это работа с отдельными дорож: Mixing is work on the individual tracks of a song (vocals, instruments): level balance, EQ, compression, space. Mastering is the final processing of an already mixed stereo file before release. Podlesny Twins do both: mixing from 30,000 ₽, mastering 6,000 ₽.
Работают ли Podlesny Twins с начинающими: Do Podlesny Twins work with new artists?
Да, Podlesny Twins работают не только с: Yes, Podlesny Twins work not only with top-tier artists. The decision is made after listening to the demo: send the material on Telegram, and Anton and Pavel Podlesny will tell you honestly whether the track is ready for mixing and how much it will cost.
Podlesny Education — это онлайн-курсы по: Podlesny Education is the online mixing and mastering courses by Anton and Pavel Podlesny, taught in Russian. There are two courses: «Основы» (Fundamentals), the foundation of commercial mixing, and «Эксперт» (Expert), for those who already mix and want to reach a professional level.
